title: Mod HUD Slot Layout
description: Which parts of the game HUD a mod replaces or hides (Content/ui/layout.json, needs the InjectUI permission). The HUD is split into slots (topbar, alerts, sidebar, rail, mapmodes, statusbar, outliner, eventpopup, armybar; the map tooltips slot cannot be changed). A replaced slot is rebuilt from a small UXML layout file that places the game's own elements by name; the game keeps them working. A slot whose layout is invalid stays as the game draws it. The slot list, each slot's element names and the required ones are in StreamingAssets/modding/hud_slots.json.

slots.description: Slot id to what the mod does with it. A slot that is not listed is left alone. With several mods the later one in load order wins.

mode.description: vanilla leaves the slot alone; replace uses the layout file; hide removes the slot from the screen (only the map modes, status bar and outliner slots can be hidden).

file.description: The layout file for replace, a UXML file inside the mod folder. Defaults to Content/ui/layouts/<slot id>.uxml.
